rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for humanity as humankind or the human species.

example.english: All of humanity has always worked hard to explore space.
example.traditional: 人類一直努力探索宇宙。
example.jyutping: jan4 leoi6 jat1 zik6 nou5 lik6 taam3 sok3 jyu5 zau6

rows.note: Use this instead of 人類 when humanity means a crowd or gathering of people in a particular place.

example.english: After the concert, humanity packed the area outside the exit.
example.traditional: 演唱會散場後，出口外面擠滿咗人群。
example.jyutping: jin2 coeng3 wui2 saan3 coeng4 hau6 ceot1 hau2 ngoi6 min6 zai1 mun5 zo2 jan4 kwan4

rows.note: Use this when humanity means human warmth, kindness, or consideration shown to others.

example.english: This cha chaan teng has a lot of humanity.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳好有人情味。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 hou2 jau5 jan4 cing4 mei6

rows.note: Use this for the human nature or human condition underlying people's behaviour.

example.english: This film is realistic and says a lot about humanity.
example.traditional: 呢套戲好寫實，講盡人性。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 se2 sat6 gong2 zeon6 jan4 sing3
